item.title: About
item.description:
I am a Computer Science and Engineering student at Daffodil International University, currently building practical skills across cybersecurity, networking, AI automation, and software development.

My current learning direction includes Cisco networking, cybersecurity bug bounty, web security, Linux, Python automation, n8n workflows, and AI agents.

Before focusing more deeply on technical work, I built experience in video editing, photography, tutoring, and campus activities. Those roles strengthened my communication, presentation, creative problem-solving, and client-facing skills.

item.title: Projects
item.description:
Automated Lead Qualification & Follow-Up

An n8n workflow for a digital-marketing lead funnel. It receives form submissions, updates Google Sheets, sends a personalized thank-you email, and notifies the owner with a Hot / Warm / Cold lead classification.

Stack: n8n, Google Forms, Google Sheets, Gmail, automation logic.

Subsequence Finder — LCS & LIS

A C-based algorithm laboratory project using dynamic programming to compute Longest Common Subsequence and Longest Increasing Subsequence results, including DP-table output and comparison metrics.
